meta.title: SunmoonAI Admin
meta.description: A production Next.js administration foundation paired with a dedicated FastAPI Admin Backend.

public.title: A secure and auditable governance console foundation
public.description: Identity, authorization, session, data access and release boundaries are governed by explicit contracts.

errors.forbiddenDescription: Your authenticated role does not allow this administration capability.

auth.logoutFailed: Sign out failed. Please try again.
auth.loginSubtitle: Authentication and session state belong to the paired FastAPI Admin Backend.
auth.loginCasdoorHint: The browser never stores provider tokens; authorization is converted into a backend-owned session.
auth.continueToDashboard: Already signed in? Open the governance console
auth.errorAuthFailed: Sign-in failed. Verify the Casdoor Admin application, callback URL and backend logs.
auth.errorNoCode: No authorization code was returned. Start sign-in again.
auth.errorOAuthGeneric: Authorization was denied or cancelled. Please try again.
auth.signupSuccessHint: Sign-up succeeded. Sign in to enter this site.

nav.governanceDescription: P0-007E will add navigation, authorization, CRUD, audit and shared tooling on this foundation.

knowbots.loadFailed: Could not load. Refresh and try again.
knowbots.noPermission: This account has no admin access (needs the admin or operator role). Sign out and sign in with an admin account.
knowbots.adminOnly: This step needs the knowlab:release permission (accept, incubate, deliver, end a stuck test). Admin and operator both have it now; otherwise switch accounts.

errorCodes.author_has_no_computer: The author has no computer to test on yet: platform tests run on the computer and folder of the author's last own test. Ask the author to connect a computer in knowbench and run one own test in knowlab, then start again.
errorCodes.test_computer_unavailable: The author's computer or folder cannot be used now (removed, or the folder is no longer allowed): ask the author to reconnect it in knowbench, then start again.
errorCodes.model_key_missing: The author has no model key in knowbench yet: platform tests and platform AI rounds run on the author's account with the author's key. Ask the author to add one in knowbench, then start again.
errorCodes.rerun_not_passed: A public, self-tested version can pass only after the platform rerun passed.
errorCodes.rerun_exists: The rerun is running or has passed.
errorCodes.category_required: Choose a category for a public expert.
errorCodes.binding_not_shareable: Some bound data is for the author's own use only, so it cannot be public.
errorCodes.binding_gone: Some bound data is no longer available to the author.
errorCodes.delivery_state: This delivery has already ended; please refresh.
errorCodes.binding_frozen_self_only: Some data frozen with this version is for the author's use only and cannot change: a new version is needed to go public.
errorCodes.rerun_attempts_used: No reruns left for this delivery (at most 3 more after platform errors): reject it, or ask the author to withdraw and submit again.
errorCodes.rerun_budget_used: The author's rerun cost limit is used up (all reruns together): reject it, or ask the author to withdraw and submit with a higher limit.
errorCodes.delivered_in_knowmart: knowmart already took this version, so it cannot be voided: retry the delivery to record it.

categories.awaiting_user: Waiting for the author to submit

knowbots.trialGates: delivered before the two gates (trial period)

input.test: Input: results and write-ups of test {number} (candidate {label})

acceptance.title: Write the acceptance
acceptance.hint: Go through the three checks; accept only when all pass. A rejection needs a reason the user can read.

check.C-L2: The test data may be used (C-L2)
check.C-L1: Within what this kind of expert does: the method comes only from the user (C-L1)

acceptance.reason: Reason (required to reject; the user can read it)
acceptance.rule: An acceptance is final; when the user revises the idea, write one for the new version.
acceptance.done: This version has its acceptance; see the right.
acceptance.trial: accepted automatically in the trial period

q.steps: What are the steps, and the rule for judging each?
q.correctness: How do you know it is right?

expect.rowMatch: Select exactly one row matching {where}, then check {field}. Missing or duplicate rows fail.

knowbots.noAnswered: No questions answered during tests yet.
knowbots.answeredTitle: Questions answered during tests (only the user's answers go into the next candidate's rule sources)

hatch.title: Incubation
hatch.pick: Which idea version to incubate (accepted ones only)
hatch.noAccepted: This name has no accepted idea version yet.
hatch.editorHint: Open this name's workdraft: cells you change are saved as proposals that count once the author accepts them; you can also start an AI round within the author's limit. Once every cell has the author's source you can publish a version (platform mode).
hatch.handBackHint: Platform incubation is done: hand the draft back; the authorisation ends, the name goes back to the author and you no longer see its workdraft.

incubation.reviewWaiting: Asked the user to review on {at}; waiting for an answer.
incubation.reviewNotOk: The user said no: {note}. Incubate again.

knowbots.reviewHint: Every rule must trace back to the user's own words in this idea version (C-L1). Read the rule sources on the right before pressing.
knowbots.review: Rule sources checked one by one

blocked.version_taken: The version this candidate aims at is already an expert; incubate again.
blocked.test_running: A test of this name is running; wait for it to end.

tests.meta: started {at} by {who} · budget {budget} CNY · timeout {timeout} s
tests.backfilled: Earlier tests left no record (before 0012 a retest of the same candidate overwrote the last one).
tests.waiting: Stopped where a person has to decide; waiting for an answer.

ended.failed: Not passed: see the results and outputs on the right, then incubate again.
ended.platform_error: Platform error; this test is over. The candidate is back to be tested, and a retest gets a new number.

knowbots.startHint: The cost limit is the one the author set in the authorisation, split evenly across cases; it runs on the author's computer with the author's key. The timeout is shared by all cases of the test, and time waiting for answers does not count.
knowbots.acceptedWaiting: Accepted, not started: waiting for the author's computer to pick it up
knowbots.blockedOffline: Accepted, not started: the author's computer is offline
knowbots.blockedFolder: Accepted, not started: the author's computer has not given a clean folder yet
knowbots.testingHint: After a refresh, the line above shows which case and step it is on; a row appears in the results on the right once a case finishes. If it is past its time with no result, end it as stuck.
knowbots.queuedLine: {case} ({done}/{total}) is queued behind a previous job on the author's account

expertStage.awaiting_user: Waiting for the author to submit

delivery.returnHint: Return: for a version the platform incubated and tested, the author gets an item in To do on the web, reads the write-ups and results, then submits it for delivery (or declines).
delivery.awaitingUser: Waiting for the author to submit it for delivery (own use or public, letting reviewers see it).
delivery.reviewHint: Review: the write-ups carry no target prices, ratings, stock picks or return promises (C-L5) and the results match the acceptance; for a self-tested version you cannot see the write-ups, so read the automatic checks and the rerun result. Choose a category for a public expert; publisher qualifications are checked in knowmart, and an unqualified one stays for own use.
delivery.stopHint: Stop: the knowmart version stops too; nobody can ask it any more, runs already going finish.

finding.test_not_passed: the test did not fully pass
finding.not_accepted: the idea version was not accepted
finding.cases_mismatch: the tested cases do not match the idea

delivery.bindingProblem: The licence pre-check of the bound data failed: {problem}
delivery.bindingsOk: {count} pieces of bound data passed the licence pre-check (frozen with this version).
delivery.rerunNeeded: Public and self-tested: start the platform rerun first (under the author's account, on the author's computer, cost limit CNY {budget}).
delivery.voidHint: Keeps failing (for example the author lowered a licence after the review and knowmart keeps refusing): void it with a reason; the author's permission for reviewers is revoked and this version goes back to waiting for the author.
delivery.held: This version is on hold in knowmart (bound data no longer valid; others cannot ask it): {reason}

listingStatus.pending: Waiting for listing review in knowmart
listingStatus.category_needed: Kept private: the seller has not chosen a category in knowmart yet
listingStatus.not_qualified: Kept private: the seller's publisher or category license is not approved yet
listingStatus.shop_suspended: Kept private: the seller's shop is suspended by the platform

event.reviewRequested: Incubation: asked the user to review candidate {label}
event.reviewOk: Review: the user said candidate {label} is fine
event.reviewNotOk: Review: the user said no to candidate {label}
event.returned: Return: expert version {version} sent to the user

amendments.title: Amendments the user wrote earlier (SDD 0035, retired): kept as history, sources still traceable. From now on a change of method is a new idea version.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.intro: Pick a version of an idea and write its acceptance after three checks: not investment advice (C-L5), the test data may be used (C-L2), within what this kind of expert does (C-L1).

incubation.title: Incubation
incubation.intro: Pick an accepted idea version and paste a manifest to incubate a candidate; you may ask the user to review it. Only candidates with checked rule sources go to testing.

tests.title: Tests
tests.intro: Run a candidate with checked rule sources through its cases; every run gets a new number. Platform errors are retested on the same candidate; a pass makes an expert.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: (Return first if the platform incubated and tested it) → the author submits it → review (own use reaches here only if automatic checks fail; public gets a full review, self-tested ones are rerun first) → deliver to knowmart. Listed versions can be stopped; All experts lists every version of every name.

name.title: Name
name.intro: The life of one name: the latest of each process, and the record in time order.

outputs.title: Write-ups and step outputs
outputs.none: This test brought back no outputs.
outputs.truncated: The write-up is long; only the first part is shown.
outputs.omitted: Output too large to bring back ({bytes} bytes)
outputs.rejectedNoCheck: The reply was not valid JSON, so no check ran.
outputs.notYet: Not fetched yet: press “Fetch outputs again”.
outputs.consentNeeded: This idea was submitted under the old test-data notice: outputs are neither fetched nor shown until the user accepts the new notice on the web.

questions.title: Questions to answer
questions.intro: The test stopped where a person has to decide; it continues once answered. We answer approvals; questions and ask-before prompts go to the user first (C-L1). If one is only about how to run, say why in one line and answer it ourselves; our answers are not the user's confirmation and are not remembered as answered prompts or put into the rule sources.
questions.withUser: With the user, waiting for an answer.
questions.judgementHint: Anything that is an investment judgement (basis, trade-off, threshold) goes back to the user.
questions.takeReason: Why this is only about how to run (one line)

side.resize: Drag to resize (arrow keys work too)

light.title: Light acceptance: the author asks for one platform test
light.hint: The author hands this self-made candidate to the platform for one test. You see only this candidate, this test set and the results; once taken it waits in Tests and still runs on the author's computer with the author's key.

workdraft.title: Workdraft
workdraft.intro: Write your method step by step in cells. It saves itself; press “Publish a version” to make a draft expert you can test.
workdraft.loadFailed: Could not load; refresh and try again.

status.failed: Not saved ({code}); change anything to retry.

workdraft.conflict: It was changed elsewhere and has been reloaded.

data.title: Data
data.hint: Picking data from your knowbase comes later; picked ids are listed here.

step.title: What this step is called
step.doesHint: A sentence or two; say here what data this step usually needs.
step.whyHint: Shown to the user while the expert works.
step.usesNone: This is the first step; nothing comes before it.
step.ask: Ask the user before the step
step.question: Question {n}
step.items: Fields of each entry in item {n}
step.nameInvalid: Names cannot be empty or contain spaces, dots, slashes, quotes or punctuation.
step.notSaved: These items are not saved until they are fixed.
step.checks: How to tell it is right
step.checksHint: Every returned item is required automatically; “returns one JSON” and “no trading advice” need no entry.
step.advancedHint: Left alone it uses the defaults: every tool, the default budget and input limit.
step.ownSchema: This step uses a hand-written output structure (brought in by an import).

onFail.rework: Redo once, then stop and ask
onFail.back: Go back to an earlier step

templates.each_has: Every entry has fields / a field takes only some values
templates.all_equal: A field of every entry equals
templates.computed: Numbers come from the compute tool
templates.covers: Covers every entry of an earlier step

problems.title: To fix before publishing
problems.noSource: No source: change this cell yourself and it counts as yours.
problems.differs: This cell differs from its record: change it yourself and it counts as yours.
problems.noOutputs: Add at least one returned item.
problems.backEarlier: Only an earlier step can be gone back to.
problems.usesEarlier: Only earlier steps can be used.
problems.checkNeeds: This check template has parameters missing: {message}
problems.checkPath: That is not an item this step returns: {message}

preview.title: The compiled manifest
preview.none: Everything holds; you can publish a version.

publish.refused: Cannot publish: some cells need fixing and are marked red.
publish.unsaved: Some changes are not saved yet: publish once they are saved.

import.title: Import an expert pack
import.hint: Paste a manifest v2 JSON or choose a file. Importing replaces the whole workdraft; what you import counts as your own words, so import only your own files.
import.invalid: This manifest cannot be imported: only manifest v2 ({code}).
import.skillHint: Paste a skill or choose a file: it is saved as a new version of your idea (kind skill); the workdraft stays as it is. Then click “AI draft” to have AI break it into steps, or write them yourself from it.
import.seedSubmit: Save as a new idea version
import.seeded: Saved as version {version} of your idea. Click “AI draft” to have AI draft from it, or write from it yourself.
import.seedFailed: Could not save ({code}). Please try again.

copy.title: Copy from my draft experts
copy.hint: Start from one of your draft experts under this name; the whole workdraft is replaced.
copy.label: Draft expert
copy.none: No draft experts under this name yet.

ai.label: AI suggestion
ai.unverified: The source does not check out: it claims to come from your words or answers, but does not match. You can only accept it after editing (edited text counts as your own words).
ai.fromProposal: This is an AI proposal: it counts only once you accept it.
ai.fromIdea: From your own words in the idea: “{quote}”
ai.draftHint: AI drafts the skeleton from your idea: the steps, what each does, what it hands back. Judgements that are yours to make (definitions, thresholds, forecasting methods, what counts as right) come only as gaps with a proposal, never written into cells. Suggestions enter the draft only when you accept them.
ai.reviseHint: Say in one line what to change, optionally for one step. AI takes your current workdraft and answered gaps and hands back suggestions; judgements come back as gaps.
ai.noComputer: You have not connected a computer yet: connect one in knowbench first.
ai.keyNote: Runs on your computer with your model key, at your cost; it stops at the limit.

errors.author_has_no_computer: You have no usable computer yet: connect one in knowbench, or pick one above.
errors.incubation_running: A round of this workdraft is already running: wait for it to finish or cancel it.
errors.incubation_unconfigured: AI incubation is not available yet. Please try again later.

ai.startFailed: Could not start. Please try again.
ai.gapsHint: These are judgements in your method: AI only asks and proposes, you decide. Answer them under To do (you can answer “as proposed”); then write the answer into the cells yourself, or click “Ask AI to change…” to take your answers along.
ai.reviseWithAnswers: Ask AI to change by my answers…
ai.started: Round {n} started: its suggestions will show next to the cells.
ai.cancelFailed: Could not cancel ({code}). Please try again.
ai.decideFailed: Could not do that ({code}). Please try again.
ai.withAnswers: Change it by the gaps I answered
ai.fromOperator: Proposed by the platform staff; it counts only once you accept it.

operatorWorkdraft.title: Platform workdraft
operatorWorkdraft.loadFailed: Not available: the author has not asked the platform, it is not accepted yet, or the authorisation was revoked or expired.
operatorWorkdraft.intro: The same cells the author uses. Your changes do not go in directly: write a reason and submit them as proposals; they count once the author accepts them on the web, and sources still come only from the author. Data picks and Advanced are the author's to decide.
operatorWorkdraft.sent: Sent {n} proposals; waiting for the author.
operatorWorkdraft.roundStarted: Started an AI round; its suggestions go to the author.

send.title: Submit as proposals ({n} changes)
send.skipped: Changes to data picks and Advanced are not sent (the author decides them).

ai.title: Start an AI round
ai.hint: Runs on the author's computer with the author's model key, within the limit set when asking the platform; suggestions go straight to the author, and you can turn them into your own proposals.

publish.title: Publish a version (platform mode)
publish.ready: Every cell has the author's source; you can publish.
publish.unsent: There are unsent changes: submit them as proposals or discard them first.
